## Access Review (Certification) Campaign — Full API Flow

All calls require an `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header. The token comes from a client-credentials grant using a PAT.

---

### Step 0 — Authenticate

```http
POST https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com/oauth/token

Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded

grant_type=client_credentials
&client_id={pat_client_id}
&client_secret={pat_client_secret}
```

The response contains `access_token`. Use it as a bearer token on every subsequent call. Rate limit is 100 requests per token per 10 seconds.

---

### Step 1 — Create the Campaign

```http
POST https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com/v3/campaigns
Authorization: Bearer {access_token}
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "name": "Q3 2026 Manager Access Review",
  "description": "Quarterly review of all manager-assigned entitlements",
  "type": "MANAGER",
  "deadline": "2026-09-30T23:59:59.000Z",
  "emailNotificationEnabled": true,
  "recommendationsEnabled": true,
  "mandatoryCommentRequirement": "REVOKE_ONLY",
  "sunsetCommentsRequired": true
}
```

**`type` values:** `MANAGER`, `SOURCE_OWNER`, `SEARCH`, `ROLE_COMPOSITION`

For a `SEARCH`-type campaign you'd also include a `searchCampaignInfo` block to define the target population via a search query.

**Response:** The full campaign object including `"id"` and `"status": "STAGED"`. Save the `id`.

**Required scope:** `idn:campaign:manage`

---

### Step 2 — Activate (Start) the Campaign

The campaign must be in `STAGED` status before activation.

```http
POST https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com/v3/campaigns/{id}/activate
Authorization: Bearer {access_token}
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "timeZone": "America/Chicago"
}
```

This submits an async job. The campaign transitions `STAGED → ACTIVE`. Reviewers receive notifications and their workitems become available.

**Required scope:** `idn:campaign:manage`

---

### Step 3 — Poll Campaign Status (Optional but Recommended)

While the activation job runs, you can poll to confirm the campaign is `ACTIVE`:

```http
GET https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com/v3/campaigns?filters=id eq "{id}"
Authorization: Bearer {access_token}
```

---

### Step 4 — Pull Results

Two sub-steps: trigger a report generation, then fetch the metadata list to get download details.

#### 4a — Run a Report

```http
POST https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com/v3/campaigns/{id}/run-report/{type}
Authorization: Bearer {access_token}
```

Common `{type}` values:
| Type | Contents |
|------|----------|
| `CAMPAIGN_COMPOSITION` | All items included in the campaign |
| `CERTIFICATION_DECISIONS` | Approve/revoke decisions made so far |

#### 4b — Fetch Report List

```http
GET https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com/v3/campaigns/{id}/reports
Authorization: Bearer {access_token}
```

Returns an array of report objects with `downloadUrl` links for each completed report.

**Required scope:** `idn:campaign-report:read` or `idn:campaign-report:manage`

---

### Summary Table

| # | Method | Path | Scope |
|---|--------|------|-------|
| 0 | `POST` | `/oauth/token` | *(PAT exchange, no scope)* |
| 1 | `POST` | `/v3/campaigns` | `idn:campaign:manage` |
| 2 | `POST` | `/v3/campaigns/{id}/activate` | `idn:campaign:manage` |
| 3 | `GET` | `/v3/campaigns` | `idn:campaign:read` |
| 4a | `POST` | `/v3/campaigns/{id}/run-report/{type}` | `idn:campaign-report:manage` |
| 4b | `GET` | `/v3/campaigns/{id}/reports` | `idn:campaign-report:read` |

---

### Key Notes

- Campaigns are created in `STAGED` status and must be explicitly activated — they don't auto-start.
- Activation is asynchronous; poll `GET /v3/campaigns` to confirm `status` becomes `ACTIVE`.
- Report generation (4a) is also async; poll `GET /v3/campaigns/{id}/reports` until the report's `status` is `COMPLETE` and a `downloadUrl` appears.
- The caller must be `ORG_ADMIN` or `CERT_ADMIN` for campaign management; `REPORT_ADMIN` is sufficient for reports.
